## General {#general .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

There are two main parts of software:

- Boot block

- Application block

## Boot block {#boot-block .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

The boot block consists of two parts:

1.Start block

2.Loader

 

1\. Start block

- Target initialization (CPU,  DFlash/RAM, if available)

- Watchdog initialization

- Reset handling (Soft resets, Reset Loop conditions)

- Tuning protection

- Test software loader for production with trigger condition

- Validity check for loader

2\. Loader

- Standard Loader (Application re-programming)

- Validity check application block

In case of customer specific controllers the loader part could have a special functionality.

## Application block {#application-block .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

After boot block is processed successfully the application is started.\
The application is generated with the help of Rexroth services, see [BSW-API](sw-api-reference-manual.html){.topiclink}.
